svg.title: FIG-10 Source SDK 独立消费 构建期流程；Native 运行与 ARM 链接分别验证 FIG-10 Independent Source SDK consumption Build-time flow; Native execution and ARM linking are separate
svg.desc: clean Git source／锁定依赖／许可 开发 fixture 必须显式选择 Clean Git source / locked dependencies / licenses Development fixtures require explicit selection; 所选 profile.packages 与包导出归属 不从单个 ELF 推导全部 SDK Selected profile.packages and package export ownership One ELF does not define the complete SDK; 打包完整 prefix；只读 verify 身份／字节 manifest schema3：source_exports／profile Package a complete prefix; verify identity/bytes read-only Manifest schema3: source_exports / profile; 移动完整 prefix 到独立路径 不只移动源码子目录 Relocate the complete prefix Do not move only its source subtree; 可选 create --public 复制 canonical GPIO 工程与显式 assembly Optional create --public Copy canonical GPIO project and explicit assembly; 外部 consumer 源码与独立 build find_package(Nexus CONFIG REQUIRED) 可显式约束 NEXUS_EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVISION External consumer source and separate build find_package(Nexus CONFIG REQUIRED) Optional NEXUS_EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVISION; 每个公共入口验证 SDK 身份与字节 source／锁／成员范围／hash Verify SDK identity and bytes at every public boundary Source / locks / member scope / hashes; nexus_add_firmware() 与包内 CMake 唯一编译目标图；私有 SDK 头不泄漏 nexus_add_firmware() and package CMake Sole compile target graph; private SDK headers stay private; 显式 host-support consumer 实际 configure／build／run Explicit host-support consumer Actual configure / build / run; 精确 MCU consumer startup／linker／ELF／BIN／map／资源 Exact MCU consumer Startup / linker / ELF / BIN / map / resources; 身份陈旧、字节变化、缺成员或错 prefix 拒绝，不继续使用旧输出 Stale identity, changed bytes, missing members or wrong prefix Reject without reusing stale output; 实际 consumer 原始记录与产物身份 不建立物理 HIL 或软件候选资格 Actual consumer records and artifact identities No physical HIL or software-candidate qualification; 选择包与依赖 Select packages and dependencies; 冻结源码输入 Frozen source inputs; 导出归属，不是编译源图 Export ownership, not a compile source graph; 完整包 Complete package; 新建公开首工程 Create a public starter; 可检查的源码与命令 Reviewable source and commands; 已有外部工程直接消费 Existing external project consumes directly; 加载公共入口 Load public entry; 身份与边界通过 Identity and boundaries accepted; 验证失败 Verification failed; 显式选中 host support Host support explicitly selected; 所选 MCU 装配 Selected MCU assembly; 实际运行结果 Actual execution results; 实际链接与资源结果 Actual link and resource results
